stories.summary: Israeli political commentator Abed Abou Shhadeh said US President Donald Trump pressured Israel into accepting a ceasefire with Lebanon, calling the agreement "problematic" from Israel's perspective.

stories.title: Trump says war on Iran 'should be ending pretty soon'
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump said at an event in Las Vegas that the war in Iran was going "swimmingly" and "should be ending pretty soon," praising US military power.

stories.title: Cuba 'ready' for possible US attack: president
stories.summary: Cuban President Miguel Díaz-Canel declared that Cuba is prepared for a possible US military attack, following months of heightened tensions between Washington and Havana.

stories.title: Manycore, one of Hangzhou’s ‘Six Little Dragons’, surges on Hong Kong IPO debut
stories.summary: Manycore Tech, a design software developer from Hangzhou known as one of the city's "Six Little Dragons," debuted on the Hong Kong stock exchange with shares surging 172 percent above the offer price. The company raised HK$1.09 billion in its IPO, positioning itself at the intersection of AI and the physical world.

stories.title: Deputy PM Kuleba comments on possibility of restoring Road Fund
stories.summary: Ukrainian Deputy Prime Minister Kuleba stated that restoring the Road Fund during wartime is feasible as a Road Logistics Fund, prioritizing evacuation routes, border checkpoint access roads, and port infrastructure.

stories.title: Macron, Starmer chair meeting to mull European post-war mission in Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron and British Prime Minister Keir Starmer are hosting a video conference with European allies to discuss deploying a multinational force to the Strait of Hormuz after the war in Iran ends. The force would ensure safe passage through the strategic waterway.

stories.title: With Art March, Hong Kong is firmly on the global cultural map
stories.summary: Hong Kong's Art March drew tens of thousands of attendees to events including Art Basel, Art Central, gallery openings, and performances. The International Cultural Summit during Art Week attracted global delegates seeking to network and explore the city's cultural venues.

stories.title: EU’s Von der Leyen welcomes the 10-day ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon
stories.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen welcomed the 10-day ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon announced by U.S. President Donald Trump. She reiterated that Europe would continue to call for respect of Lebanon's territorial integrity.

stories.title: Progressive Democrat Analilia Mejia wins New Jersey special election for US House
stories.summary: Democrat Analilia Mejia won a New Jersey special election for the U.S. House, defeating Republican Joe Hathaway in the 11th congressional district. Mejia, backed by Senator Bernie Sanders, will fill the seat previously held by Democratic Governor Mikie Sherrill.

stories.title: Australia acts to protect winter crops with emergency Indonesian fertiliser deal
stories.summary: An Australian company will import 250,000 tonnes of urea fertiliser from Indonesia to avert a shortage threatening winter crop production. Australia depends on fertiliser imports that have been disrupted by the Iran conflict, which has cut Middle Eastern supply and driven up urea prices.

stories.title: Trump says Iran agrees to hand over its enriched uranium
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump said Thursday that Iran had agreed to hand over its enriched uranium, adding that Washington and Tehran were very close to reaching a peace deal.

stories.title: FBI under Trump ramps up probe of ex-CIA chief Brennan over Russia report, sources say
stories.summary: The FBI under the Trump administration has intensified its criminal investigation of former CIA Director John Brennan regarding the 2017 U.S. intelligence assessment that concluded Russia interfered in the 2016 election. Investigators plan to question roughly half a dozen witnesses in the probe.

stories.title: Middle East war live: Lebanon accuses Israel of violating ceasefire, displaced return to south
stories.summary: The Lebanese army accused Israel of committing multiple violations shortly after a 10-day ceasefire took effect. Simultaneously, displaced residents began returning to southern Lebanon, with the army urging them to exercise caution.

stories.title: Bennett unveils plan for increasing disability access across Israel
stories.summary: Former Israeli Prime Minister Naftali Bennett announced a plan to increase disability access across Israel, pledging to improve accessibility, integrate disabled individuals into the workforce, and expand inclusion in the IDF.

stories.title: Lebanon says Israel commits violations hours after ceasefire took effect
stories.summary: The Lebanese army reported that Israel committed several ceasefire violations hours after the truce took effect, including intermittent shelling of southern Lebanese villages. The army warned citizens against returning to southern towns. Israel's military did not immediately comment.

stories.title: DNA analysis identifies members of Oregon family missing since 1958
stories.summary: DNA analysis by Oregon's state medical examiner identified remains found in a car in the Columbia River as those of Kenneth and Barbara Martin and their daughter Barbie, who went missing in 1958. The Hood River County sheriff's office concluded its investigation into the case.

stories.title: Celebrations on the road as people begin returning to southern Lebanon
stories.summary: Tens of thousands of displaced people began returning to southern Lebanon by road following the ceasefire announcement between Lebanon and Israel.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz arrives in Turkiye on third leg of tri-nation tour, holds meeting with FM Fidan
stories.summary: Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif arrived in Antalya, Türkiye, on the third leg of a tri-nation tour after visiting Saudi Arabia and Qatar. He held a meeting with Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan, joined by Deputy PM Ishaq Dar and Special Assistant Tariq Fatemi.

stories.title: IMF warns of war's human impact far from Middle East
stories.summary: IMF economists warned that the war in Iran could have severe economic consequences well beyond the Middle East, particularly for energy-importing nations dependent on Gulf oil supplies.

stories.title: A dirge without end: March of the Living ceremony presents Jewish life, honors Holocaust survivors
stories.summary: The March of the Living ceremony honored Holocaust survivors and highlighted ongoing Jewish resilience. Agam Berger, a survivor of the October 7 Hamas attack, played a violin donated to Yad Vashem by Israeli relatives of a Holocaust survivor.

stories.title: China’s AI firms scaled up on open-source models. The next phase may be different
stories.summary: Chinese AI firms have widely adopted open-source model releases as a core business strategy despite the competitive market. Alibaba chairman Joe Tsai explained at the University of Hong Kong that open-sourcing AI lowers costs globally and attracts talent, though the industry's next phase may shift away from this approach.

stories.title: US Defence Secretary Hegseth invokes Bible to compare reporters to enemies of Jesus
stories.summary: U.S. Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth invoked biblical language to compare reporters to enemies of Jesus. His comments were reportedly aimed at countering what he views as negative media coverage of the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran.

stories.title: 8 killed, 11 injured as gas supply line catches fire in KP’s Haripur
stories.summary: At least eight people, including children, were killed and 11 others injured when a Sui Northern Gas supply line near a factory in the Hattar Industrial Estate of Haripur district, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan, burst and caught fire. The cause of the explosion has not yet been determined.

stories.title: Trump says if Iran deal is reached and signed in Islamabad, ‘I might go’ there
stories.summary: President Trump said he might travel to Islamabad if a deal with Iran is reached and signed there. He claimed Iran had agreed to "almost everything" and that the two sides were "very close" to a peace deal.

stories.title: Police investigate bomb threat at Chicago-area home of Pope Leo’s brother
stories.summary: Police investigated a bomb threat at the Chicago-area home of John Prevost, the brother of Pope Leo. A search of the property found no explosives or hazardous materials.

stories.title: Police investigate bomb threat at Chicago-area home of Pope Leo's brother
stories.summary: Police in the Chicago area investigated a bomb threat made against the home of John Prevost, brother of Pope Leo XIV. A search of the property found no explosives or hazardous materials.

stories.title: Hormuz must open, G7 ready to mitigate war fallout: France FM
stories.summary: France's finance minister stated that the Strait of Hormuz must be reopened and that G7 leaders are prepared to mitigate the economic fallout from the war involving Iran.

stories.title: Trump says he hopes Hezbollah 'acts nicely and well'
stories.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump posted on Truth Social urging Hezbollah to "act nicely and well" during the 10-day ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon, calling for an end to killing and for peace.

stories.title: Russian propagandist’s interview sparks debate over whether he deserves sympathy
stories.summary: On April 13, Ksenia Sobchak released an interview with Anton Krasovsky, a former liberal journalist turned pro-war propagandist who was fired from RT for calling for violence against Ukrainian children. Krasovsky, who is openly gay and founded an HIV foundation, now supports Russia's ban on LGBTQ+ expression.

stories.title: Ten-day Lebanon-Israel ceasefire begins after weeks of conflict
stories.summary: A ten-day ceasefire between Lebanon and Israel took effect as U.S. President Donald Trump pushes for broader regional diplomacy, including a possible first-ever leaders' meeting. The truce follows weeks of intense fighting and heavy casualties linked to wider conflict involving Iran.

stories.title: US House Republicans narrowly block latest bid to rein in Trump’s Iran war powers
stories.summary: The U.S. House of Representatives narrowly defeated a war powers resolution aimed at reining in President Trump's authority over the Iran conflict, with a vote of 214 to 213. The measure failed in the Republican-majority chamber.

stories.title: US House Republicans block latest bid to rein in Trump Iran war powers
stories.summary: The U.S. House of Representatives narrowly defeated a Democratic-led resolution that sought to halt military operations against Iran until Congress formally authorized hostilities. The vote effectively backed President Donald Trump's ongoing military campaign.

stories.title: MK Boaz Bismuth attacked by haredi mob in Bnei Brak, affirms dedication to draft law
stories.summary: Israeli lawmaker Boaz Bismuth was attacked by a Haredi mob in Bnei Brak. Police intervened and removed him from the scene without injury. Bismuth reaffirmed his commitment to advancing the military draft law.

stories.title: Iranian footballers say Australia has given them 'hope' for safe future
stories.summary: Two Iranian footballers sought asylum in Australia after their team refused to sing Iran's national anthem during a match. They stated that Australia has given them hope for a safe future.

stories.title: Bars gearing up for bumper Hong Kong Sevens weekend
stories.summary: Bars and restaurants in Hong Kong are anticipating strong business during the three-day Hong Kong Sevens rugby tournament, with some operators expecting up to 40 percent more trade than a regular weekend. Rising airfares due to the Middle East conflict have not significantly dampened visitor interest.

stories.title: Iran’s shadow oil trade endures near Singapore despite war
stories.summary: Iran's shadow oil trade continues near Singapore despite the ongoing war, helping Tehran evade sanctions and maintain crude exports to China.

stories.title: Ukraine war briefing: €90bn EU loan for Ukraine to be released in second quarter
stories.summary: The European Union expects to begin releasing a new €90 billion loan to Ukraine in the second quarter, according to EU economy commissioner Valdis Dombrovskis. He spoke on the sidelines of the IMF and World Bank spring meetings in Washington.

stories.title: Gaza civil defence says Israeli fire kills four, including child
stories.summary: Gaza's civil defense agency reported that Israeli fire killed four people, including one child, in multiple locations across the Palestinian territory on Thursday.

stories.title: Israel and Lebanon agree to 10-day truce, Trump announces
stories.summary: President Donald Trump announced that Israel and Lebanon have agreed to a 10-day truce, saying he wanted to create "a little breathing room" between the two countries.

stories.title: Trump says US "very close" to Iran deal and announces Israel-Lebanon ceasefire
stories.summary: President Donald Trump announced a 10-day ceasefire agreement between Israel and Lebanon and said Washington is "very close" to reaching a deal with Iran. Trump coupled the diplomatic developments with explicit threats to resume hostilities if Tehran does not accept American terms.

stories.title: North Korea’s Kim ramps up show of force as US war on Iran raises stakes
stories.summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong-un has increased his appearances at military events, including drills and missile tests, as the U.S.-led war on Iran commands global attention. Analysts suggest Kim feels more secure in his nuclear deterrence as Washington's focus is stretched across multiple fronts.

stories.title: Iran war live: Ceasefire starts in Lebanon as Trump says Tehran deal close
stories.summary: The death toll from Israeli attacks on Lebanon reached 2,196 as a 10-day ceasefire took effect. US President Trump indicated that a broader deal with Tehran was close.

stories.title: Ukrainian PM meets with IMF chief in Washington
stories.summary: Ukrainian Prime Minister Yuliia Svyrydenko met with IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva in Washington, D.C. during the Spring Meetings of the IMF and World Bank. The discussions focused on ongoing cooperation and Ukraine's reform agenda.

stories.title: 'I was tortured and lost my hand' - one student's struggle to get an education in Nigeria
stories.summary: A Nigerian student recounted being tortured and losing his hand, then struggling to verify his identity for educational purposes. He pushed authorities to accept his toe print as an alternative form of identification.

stories.title: UN chief urges full respect for Israel-Lebanon ceasefire
stories.summary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres welcomed the 10-day ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon and commended the United States' role in facilitating it. He urged all parties to respect the agreement and expressed hope it would lead to further negotiations.

stories.title: Australia news live: bail hearing for accused war criminal Ben Roberts-Smith; refinery fire will not mean tougher fuel restrictions, PM says
stories.summary: Australian Prime Minister Albanese said 80% of diesel and aviation fuel production continues despite disruptions related to the effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz. Australia has secured additional fertilizer supplies and 100 million extra litres of fuel through talks with Asian allies.

stories.title: Ukraine is developing its own unstoppable air-launched missile
stories.summary: Ukraine is developing its own air-launched ballistic missile, modeled on Russia's Kinzhal, which is considered extremely difficult to intercept by existing air defense systems.

stories.title: Suspect in 1982 Paris Jewish restaurant attack extradited to France
stories.summary: Hicham Harb, a 72-year-old suspect in the 1982 attack on a Jewish restaurant in Paris that killed six people, was extradited to France by the Palestinian Authority on Thursday. He was detained upon arrival in Paris and will face formal legal proceedings.

stories.title: Many peptides are named to sound like Yiddish words. Here’s why
stories.summary: USC researcher Pinchas Cohen has named several peptide discoveries after Yiddish words, including SHLP, SHMOOSE, and MENTSH. These biological molecules are being studied for their potential to treat ailments and reverse aging.

stories.title: IMF, World Bank say they are resuming dealings with Venezuela
stories.summary: The International Monetary Fund and World Bank announced they have resumed dealings with Venezuela after a pause since 2019. The move could lead to the first full IMF assessment of Venezuela's economy in approximately 20 years and potentially unlock billions in frozen special drawing rights.

stories.title: Why biggest threat to US’ global dollar dominance may well be Washington itself
stories.summary: At a hearing before a U.S. congressional advisory committee, witnesses testified that while China has built markets and mechanisms to reduce dependence on the U.S. dollar, Washington's own policies—including economic sanctions—may pose the greatest threat to the dollar's global dominance.

stories.title: Israeli Army fire kills Palestinian teen in West Bank
stories.summary: Palestinian teenager Mohammed Murad Mahmud Rayan was killed by Israeli forces on Thursday morning in the West Bank village of Beit Duqqu, north of Jerusalem, according to the Ramallah-based Palestinian Health Ministry.

stories.title: Injury toll from Russian attack on Kyiv rises to 65
stories.summary: The number of people injured in a Russian attack on Kyiv on April 16 rose to 65, with 35 of those injured currently hospitalized.

stories.title: Trump says second round of talks with Iran could take place this weekend
stories.summary: President Trump claimed Tehran has agreed to surrender its nuclear materials and said a second round of U.S.-Iran talks could occur over the weekend. Iran's UN envoy described himself as "cautiously optimistic" about the negotiations.

stories.title: Israeli shelling continues in Lebanon after ceasefire takes effect
stories.summary: Lebanon's National News Agency reported that Israeli artillery struck the southern towns of Khiam and Dibbine shortly after the ceasefire took effect. Israeli reconnaissance aircraft were also active over the Bekaa Valley's Rashaya region.

stories.title: Syria says takes over northeast base after international coalition pullout
stories.summary: The Syrian army announced it has taken control of the Qasrak air base following the withdrawal of international coalition forces. The development was reported by state news agency SANA, citing a defence ministry statement.

stories.title: Justin Fairfax, ex-lieutenant governor of Virginia, kills wife and himself
stories.summary: Former Virginia Lieutenant Governor Justin Fairfax shot and killed his wife Cerina Fairfax before killing himself at their Annandale home, police said. The couple's teenage children called 911. Police described the incident as occurring amid an ongoing domestic dispute related to divorce proceedings.

stories.title: German rescuers plan to use air cushions to save Timmy stranded whale
stories.summary: A whale nicknamed Timmy is stranded in shallow waters near the eastern German town of Wismar and has barely moved for days. German rescuers are planning to use air cushions in an effort to save the animal amid fears it may die.

stories.title: Pakistan Army chief Munir holds talks with top Iranian leadership in Tehran
stories.summary: Pakistan Army Chief General Asim Munir held talks with senior Iranian leadership in Tehran, including the commander of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. Discussions focused on steps taken under a framework for ending the war and recent bilateral negotiations.

stories.title: Three arrested after attempted arson at Persian-language media office in London
stories.summary: Three people were arrested in London after an attempted arson attack on a Persian-language media office. Officials had previously warned of threats against journalists working for Persian-language outlets.

stories.title: Russia sentences Pole who fought for Ukraine to 13 years in prison camp
stories.summary: A court in Russian-controlled Luhansk sentenced a Polish citizen to 13 years in a maximum-security penal colony for fighting on Ukraine's side in the armed conflict.

stories.title: UN Sudan chief says country 'abandoned' after three years of war
stories.summary: The top UN official in Sudan said the country has been "abandoned" by the international community as the war between the Sudanese military and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces enters its fourth year.

stories.title: Brazil never supported Russia's war against Ukraine – Lula
stories.summary: Brazilian President Lula da Silva stated that Brazil has never supported Russia's war against Ukraine and has not recognized Moscow's right to occupy Ukrainian territories.

stories.title: Pope blasts ‘tyrants’ ravaging Earth during Cameroon visit
stories.summary: Pope Leo, during a visit to Cameroon, praised peace movements and warned against allowing religion to be drawn into conflicts. He directed sharp criticism at leaders he called "tyrants" who exploit faith for military, economic, and political gain.

stories.title: Department of Justice investigating Eric Swalwell amid sexual assault allegations
stories.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice has opened an investigation into former California Representative Eric Swalwell following his resignation from Congress amid multiple sexual misconduct allegations. Swalwell had also suspended his California gubernatorial campaign.

stories.title: Lebanon death toll rises to 2,196
stories.summary: Lebanon's National News Agency reported the cumulative death toll from Israeli attacks in Lebanon has reached 2,196, with 7,185 others wounded.

stories.title: Kremlin acknowledges criticism after blogger warns Putin 'squeezed' Russians could erupt
stories.summary: The Kremlin publicly acknowledged sharp criticism from celebrity blogger and social media influencer Viktoria Bonya, who warned that economically squeezed Russians could erupt. Kremlin officials said work was under way to address the problems she identified.

stories.title: ‘Half his head is gone’: Odesa parents on horror of Russian attack
stories.summary: Russia launched nearly 700 drones and dozens of ballistic and cruise missiles across Ukraine in one of its deadliest overnight attacks in weeks. At least nine people were killed in the southern port city of Odesa, with additional fatalities reported elsewhere.

stories.title: US intends to lead Hezbollah disarmament, senior Israeli official tells 'Post' - exclusive
stories.summary: A senior Israeli official told the Jerusalem Post that the United States intends to lead efforts to disarm Hezbollah. The official described the current ceasefire terms as significantly better than those negotiated in November 2024.

stories.title: G7 warns prolonged Middle East war risks global economic damage
stories.summary: G7 finance ministers and central bank governors, meeting alongside IMF and World Bank gatherings in Washington, warned that a prolonged Middle East war could cause significant global economic damage and called for efforts toward lasting peace.

stories.title: Trump's Lebanon ceasefire takes Israel by surprise
stories.summary: President Trump announced a ceasefire in Lebanon that reportedly caught Israeli officials off guard. According to the BBC, few Israelis view the truce as a viable path to resolving the broader conflict with Hezbollah in southern Lebanon.

stories.title: People in Beirut wary of trusting Israel will uphold Lebanon ceasefire
stories.summary: Residents of Beirut expressed skepticism about whether Israel will uphold the ceasefire agreement announced by U.S. President Donald Trump between Israel and Lebanon.

stories.title: Brazilian President Lula says Trump has ‘no right’ to threaten countries
stories.summary: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva said U.S. President Donald Trump has "no right" to threaten other countries. His comments followed Trump's warning that "a whole civilisation will die" in Iran if it did not open the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Cuba ‘ready’ for possible US attack: president
stories.summary: Cuban President Miguel Díaz-Canel declared at a rally in Havana marking the 65th anniversary of the Bay of Pigs invasion that Cuba is prepared for a possible U.S. attack. His remarks follow repeated warnings from U.S. President Donald Trump suggesting Cuba could be a target after actions against Venezuela.

stories.title: Uruguay says RAF Falklands flight was medevac; Tierra del Fuego alleges airspace breach
stories.summary: Uruguay's Ministry of Defense confirmed that a Royal Air Force Airbus A400M flight between the Falkland Islands and Montevideo was an authorized medical evacuation of two patients. The flight was permitted under Uruguayan decree 419/021, which allows foreign military aircraft landings for humanitarian reasons.

stories.title: After ceasefire enters into force, Trump tells Hezbollah to ‘act nicely and well’
stories.summary: After the Israel-Lebanon ceasefire took effect, President Trump urged Hezbollah to "act nicely and well." A senior Iranian leader claimed credit for the truce as displaced residents began returning to Hezbollah's Beirut stronghold.

stories.title: Trump claims Iran 'totally agreed' to give up nuclear ambitions
stories.summary: President Trump claimed that Iran has "totally agreed" to abandon its nuclear ambitions and agreed to "almost everything." However, no formal deal was reached during Saturday's negotiations between the two sides.

stories.title: Israel and Lebanon’s 10-day ceasefire goes into effect
stories.summary: A 10-day ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon took effect at midnight local time (21:00 GMT), pausing hostilities between the two sides.

stories.title: Hours after ceasefire announcement, Hezbollah barrage leads to one severely wounded
stories.summary: Shortly after the ceasefire announcement, a Hezbollah rocket barrage left one person severely wounded. Magen David Adom treated several others with light injuries and anxiety-related symptoms in the affected area.

stories.title: Trump-imposed truce between Israel and Hezbollah takes effect; 2 badly hurt by rocket fire hours before
stories.summary: A U.S.-brokered 10-day ceasefire between Israel and Hezbollah took effect, with Trump announcing that Israeli and Lebanese leaders would discuss a permanent peace deal at the White House. Two people were badly hurt by rocket fire hours before the truce began.

stories.title: World Bank-IMF meeting in US reaffirms support for Ukraine – Svyrydenko
stories.summary: A ministerial roundtable hosted by the World Bank and IMF in the United States reaffirmed international support for Ukraine, according to Ukrainian official Svyrydenko. Kyiv expects the unblocking of a EUR 90 billion EU loan in the near future.

stories.title: Watch: Delimitation row erupts in Parliament: What happened? | Above the Fold | 16.04.2026
stories.summary: India's Lok Sabha saw a contentious session as the ruling Centre and the Opposition clashed over delimitation proposals. The parliamentary debate is covered in the third episode of the news program Above the Fold, which also discusses the West Asia conflict and a Supreme Court observation on voting rights.

stories.title: China willing to ‘buy’ or ‘steal’ US tech to get ahead in AI race, Congress told
stories.summary: At a U.S. congressional hearing, lawmakers and experts accused China of buying and stealing American technology to advance in the artificial intelligence race. Witnesses also warned that U.S. immigration and research policies could be hindering the innovation needed to maintain America's competitive edge.

stories.title: 'How does one survive?': Factory protests expose strain in India's industrial system
stories.summary: Workers in several north Indian cities have staged protests demanding better pay and improved working conditions, highlighting strains within India's industrial labor system.

stories.title: IRGC commander says Hezbollah ‘winner’ as Lebanon ceasefire holds
stories.summary: Iran's Quds Force commander Esmail Qaani declared Hezbollah the victor as the Lebanon ceasefire held, crediting the truce to what he described as the resilience of Lebanese resistance and Iranian support.

stories.title: No ‘specific request’ to help US in strait of Hormuz, Marles says, as Trump repeats criticism of Australia
stories.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump accused Australia of not doing enough to support American operations in the Middle East, claiming the U.S. had asked for Australian assistance. Australian Defence Minister Richard Marles said there had been no specific request from Washington to help in the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: EU lawmaker warns of potential information leaks to Russia from European Parliament
stories.summary: An EU lawmaker raised concerns that sensitive information from the European Parliament could be leaked to Russia. Suspicions center on pro-Russian lawmakers and their staff operating within the Brussels institution.

stories.title: Trump announces 10-day ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump announced a 10-day ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon and said he would invite the Israeli Prime Minister and Lebanese president to the White House for talks.

stories.title: Displaced Lebanese wary as ceasefire between Israel and Hezbollah begins
stories.summary: Displaced Lebanese evacuees remained cautious as the ceasefire between Israel and Hezbollah began, waiting for clarity on the truce's terms before attempting to return to their villages.

stories.title: Diamond coating nearly doubles Chinese AI data centre’s cooling efficiency
stories.summary: Chinese researchers from the Ningbo Institute of Industrial Technology developed a diamond-copper composite material that improves AI data center cooling efficiency by up to 80 percent. The material has already been deployed in an AI computing node in Zhengzhou, Henan province.

stories.title: US will help Peru ‘take back’ Chancay port from China, Congress chair says
stories.summary: U.S. Congresswoman Maria Elvira Salazar, chair of the House Foreign Affairs Subcommittee on the Western Hemisphere, called on Peru's next government to reclaim the Chinese-controlled Chancay deepwater port, describing it as a military threat. She said Washington would assist Peru in the effort.

stories.title: Pope Leo slams 'those who manipulate religion' for war, as White House invokes divine calling
stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV issued a strong condemnation of those who use religion to justify military and political objectives, in what was widely interpreted as a critique of the Trump administration's biblical invocations regarding the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran.

stories.title: Security arrangements in Islamabad in overdrive amid possible 2nd round of US-Iran talks
stories.summary: Security arrangements in Islamabad were heightened amid speculation that the Pakistani capital may host a second round of US-Iran talks. Police officials noted manpower shortages, and road resurfacing began on the route from Nur Khan Airbase to the Red Zone.

stories.title: Russia summons Mexican envoy over case involving young Russian girl held in 'illegal custody'
stories.summary: Russia summoned Mexico's ambassador to express concern over an underage Russian citizen reportedly held in the custody of Mexican social services. Moscow accused Mexican authorities of inaction in the case.

stories.title: EU and NATO to work to strengthen relationship, von der Leyen says
stories.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said she and NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte agreed to work in the coming weeks to strengthen the EU-NATO relationship.

stories.title: Zelensky, Jetten honor WWII victims
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten jointly honored the memory of military personnel and civilians killed during World War II in a commemorative ceremony.

stories.title: Democrats join Republicans to block limits on US arms sales to Israel
stories.summary: Several pro-Israel Democratic senators joined Republicans to defeat a resolution led by Senator Bernie Sanders that sought to block U.S. military bulldozer sales to Israel. The measure failed in a 40–59 vote.

stories.title: Trump says Israel, Lebanon have agreed to 10-day ceasefire
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump announced that Israel and Lebanon have agreed to a 10-day ceasefire. Israeli attacks in Lebanon since March 2 have killed more than 2,100 people and displaced over 1.2 million, according to Lebanese authorities. Hezbollah attacks have killed two Israeli civilians and 13 Israeli soldiers.

stories.title: Netflix cofounder Hastings to step down after it lost Warner Bros deal
stories.summary: Netflix co-founder Reed Hastings announced he will step down from the company following the loss of a deal with Warner Bros. The company's stock fell approximately 8 percent on the news.

stories.title: ‘First of its kind’ flying taxi station completed in Dubai
stories.summary: Dubai has completed its first purpose-built electric vertical take-off and landing air taxi station, with commercial operations expected to begin by the end of 2025. Crown Prince Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed visited the facility, described by authorities as the first of its kind.

stories.title: Suspect kills police officer, wounds 3 in Russia’s Orenburg Region before fleeing
stories.summary: A police officer was killed and three others wounded during an attempted detention in Russia's Orenburg Region. The suspect fled the scene and remains at large as authorities conduct a search.

stories.title: Trump nominates Erica Schwartz, ex-deputy surgeon general, as CDC director
stories.summary: President Donald Trump nominated Dr. Erica Schwartz to lead the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Schwartz served as deputy surgeon general during Trump's first administration and holds the rank of rear admiral in the U.S. Coast Guard.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz arrives in Turkiye on third leg of tri-nation tour
stories.summary: Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif arrived in Antalya, Turkiye, on the third leg of a tri-nation tour that included visits to Saudi Arabia and Qatar. In Qatar, he met with Emir Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani.

stories.title: Without restraint, Beijing and Manila can’t deliver the South China Sea code
stories.summary: Negotiations between China, the Philippines, and other ASEAN members on a South China Sea code of conduct may conclude this year. Beijing has signaled hope of finishing talks by year-end, while Manila has repeatedly expressed its intent to reach an agreement, though tensions between the parties remain a challenge.

stories.title: US House rejects bid to curb Trump's Iran war powers
stories.summary: The U.S. House of Representatives voted down a Democratic-led effort to limit President Trump's authority to wage war in Iran, marking another legislative setback for opponents of the conflict.

stories.title: US’ Greer pushes for funds to escalate Trump’s trade war with China
stories.summary: U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer sought additional funding from Congress to support President Trump's trade wars with China. The request came ahead of a planned summit between Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping on May 14-15, with Greer insisting the U.S. would not yield to Beijing's retaliatory measures.

stories.title: Senate rejects blocking military aid to Israel, but bills gain majority Democrat support
stories.summary: The U.S. Senate rejected two joint resolutions introduced by Senator Bernie Sanders in March that sought to block military aid to Israel. Resolution 32 was defeated 40–59 and Resolution 138 was defeated 36–63, though both received majority support from Democratic senators.

stories.title: Czech-led ammunition initiative for Ukraine delivering real results – Rutte
stories.summary: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte endorsed the Czech-led ammunition initiative for Ukraine, saying it is delivering real results. Rutte urged allied nations to continue funding the procurement of artillery ammunition under the program.

stories.title: US House votes to extend temporary protections for Haitians in Trump rebuke
stories.summary: The U.S. House of Representatives voted to extend Temporary Protected Status for nearly 350,000 Haitians, with ten Republican members joining Democrats to pass the measure in a rebuke of President Trump.

stories.title: Israeli strikes kill dozens in Lebanon hours before ceasefire
stories.summary: Israeli forces carried out more than a dozen strikes across southern Lebanon in the hours before the 10-day ceasefire took effect at 21:00 GMT, killing and wounding people in areas including Adloun and Zefta.

stories.title: “Russia wants more war” – EU’s Kallas pushes €90 billion loan and 20th sanctions after deadliest April strike
stories.summary: EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas accused Russia of conducting "terror against the innocent" following the deadliest April strike on Ukraine and pushed for a €90 billion loan and a 20th round of sanctions against Moscow.

stories.title: Frenchman jailed for hit-and-run in Israel is shot dead in upscale Paris street
stories.summary: Eric Robic, a Frenchman previously jailed for a fatal hit-and-run that killed Israeli woman Lee Zeitouni in 2011, was shot dead on an upscale street in Paris.

stories.title: France finance minister says Hormuz must open 'but not at any price'
stories.summary: France and Britain will co-host a video conference of countries willing to contribute to a defensive mission to secure the Strait of Hormuz. French Finance Minister stated the strait must be reopened but "not at any price." Analysts describe the initiative as Europe's attempt to reinsert itself into a crisis shaped by U.S. and Israeli decisions.

stories.title: Turkiye grieves students killed in school shooting
stories.summary: Hundreds of mourners attended funerals in Kahramanmaras, Türkiye, for eight students who were fatally shot in a school shooting.

stories.title: Editor's Notes: What kind of Jewish state are we becoming? Reflecting on Independence Day - comment
stories.summary: As Israel marks 78 years of independence, questions about the country's evolving identity as a Jewish state are being raised. The commentary reflects on Zionism, national unity, and the meaning of statehood on Independence Day.

stories.title: Behind the scenes of the Israel-Lebanon ceasefire: Why did Netanyahu, Aoun agree to 10-day truce?
stories.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu told a security cabinet meeting that the decision to agree to the Lebanon ceasefire came at the request of President Trump. Cabinet members had asked what prompted the sudden shift in Israel's position.

stories.title: Bennett launches national disability inclusion plan, pledges accessibility reforms if elected
stories.summary: Former Prime Minister Naftali Bennett announced a national disability inclusion plan at an event in Bnei Brak. He stated that Israel has 1.2 million people with disabilities and pledged accessibility reforms if elected.

stories.title: Pope Leo urges peace in visit to Cameroon’s conflict-hit northwest
stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV visited Bamenda in northwest Cameroon, a region affected by prolonged armed conflict, and called for peace during his trip.

stories.title: What is tailgating, and has FIFA banned it at World Cup stadiums in the US?
stories.summary: FIFA and local organizers have moved to ban tailgating at 2026 World Cup stadiums in the United States, drawing criticism from American football fans over the restriction.

stories.title: School shootings a new trauma for Turkey as nation mourns
stories.summary: Turkey is mourning after a school shooting in the city of Kahramanmaraş. An expert told the BBC the attack was a tragedy but "not a surprise," suggesting underlying issues contributing to such violence in the country.

stories.title: Russia-linked crypto exchange involved in sanctions evasion suspends operations after hack
stories.summary: Grinex, a Russia-linked cryptocurrency exchange reportedly involved in sanctions evasion, suspended operations after what it described as a large-scale cyberattack. The exchange claimed the hack bore signs of foreign intelligence involvement.

stories.title: DM Fedorov, Diehl Defence CEO discuss boosting Ukraine’s air defense capabilities
stories.summary: Ukrainian Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov met with Diehl Defence CEO Helmut Rauch to discuss strengthening Ukraine's air defense capabilities. The talks focused on concrete measures to reinforce defenses against aerial threats.

stories.title: Hezbollah urges residents to delay returning to southern Lebanon, ahead of ceasefire
stories.summary: Hezbollah urged residents to delay returning to southern Lebanon, the Bekaa Valley, and Beirut's southern suburbs ahead of a ceasefire with Israel. The group cited concerns about Israeli violations, calling on people to wait until the situation is clear.

stories.title: Iran war opens new rifts between Washington, Europe, the Vatican, and Israel
stories.summary: Disagreements over Iran, Lebanon, NATO obligations, and diplomatic legitimacy are straining relations among Washington, European capitals, the Vatican, and Israel. The disputes are testing Western alliance cohesion on multiple fronts.

stories.title: A ceasefire in Lebanon — will it hold?
stories.summary: A ceasefire in Lebanon has taken effect following rare negotiations, but questions remain about whether it will hold on the ground.

stories.title: America is in a losing position in the Gulf, but Israel is winning: University of Oklahoma Professor Joshua Landis
stories.summary: University of Oklahoma Professor Joshua Landis told The Hindu that the US blockade of Iran is likely to fail. He argued that Israel, which opposes the ceasefire with Iran, would attempt to draw the US back into conflict with Tehran.

stories.title: Qatar hosts talks aimed at putting Iran peace process back on track
stories.summary: Pakistan's Prime Minister arrived in Doha, Qatar, on Thursday for regional talks aimed at reviving the Iran peace process and exploring paths to end the war in the Middle East.

stories.title: Co-founder Reed Hastings to step down from Netflix board
stories.summary: Netflix co-founder and chair Reed Hastings announced he will not seek re-election to the company's board at its annual meeting in June. The company said his departure was not due to any disagreement, and Hastings plans to focus on philanthropy.

stories.title: South African opposition leader Malema gets jail sentence
stories.summary: South African opposition leader Julius Malema of the Economic Freedom Fighters was sentenced to five years in prison after being convicted of firearm offences.

stories.title: Border Police officers sent to jail for barbecuing on base over Shabbat
stories.summary: Four Israeli Border Police medics were sentenced to jail time for barbecuing on their base during Shabbat, a punishment described as addressing harm to religion and Judaism. The sentence was reportedly reduced from two weeks to one after public backlash.

stories.title: European airlines could run out of jet fuel 'in six weeks'
stories.summary: International Energy Agency chief Fatih Birol warned that European airlines could run out of jet fuel within six weeks due to ongoing energy disruptions. Airlines are already reducing flight schedules ahead of the summer season. European officials also urged governments not to overlook the Ukraine war, warning against allowing Russia's economy to benefit from the energy shock.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia pressed US to secure a Lebanon ceasefire to preserve Iran negotiations, sources say
stories.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman pressed US President Donald Trump in a private phone call to prioritize securing a Lebanon ceasefire in order to preserve ongoing negotiations with Iran. Saudi Arabia has also shifted toward mediation efforts aimed at reopening the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Who is keeping the fight alive in Sudan’s war?
stories.summary: Sudan's war between the military and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces has entered its fourth year, devastating the country's population and infrastructure.

stories.title: General Staff confirms hits on Tuapse oil refinery, multiple military sites in Russia and occupied areas
stories.summary: Ukraine's General Staff confirmed strikes on the Tuapse oil refinery and multiple military sites in Russia and occupied territories. The attacks were carried out overnight and during the day on April 16.

stories.title: More than $5 trillion in US taxes. Who gets it?
stories.summary: The U.S. federal government collects more than $5 trillion in annual taxes, with budget allocations spanning war spending and healthcare generating debate over spending priorities.

stories.title: AOC, Boebert join calls for sexual misconduct accountability in Congress
stories.summary: Representatives Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and Lauren Boebert, from opposing political flanks, jointly called for reforms to address sexual misconduct accountability in Congress after several members resigned.

stories.title: Report: Russian courts begin treating VPN use as aggravating circumstance in drug cases
stories.summary: Russian courts have begun treating VPN use as an aggravating circumstance in criminal drug cases under 2025 legal amendments. Independent outlet Verstka identified the first two cases in which the new provisions were applied.

stories.title: Explainer-Iran war exposes weakened state of Britain's armed forces
stories.summary: The Iran war has exposed significant weaknesses in Britain's armed forces, increasing pressure on Prime Minister Keir Starmer to follow through on defense investment pledges. Military leaders had previously warned about the UK's shrinking military capabilities.

stories.title: A week into ceasefire, Israelis’ storied resilience is tested by questions about what was gained
stories.summary: One week into the ceasefire, many Israelis are returning to normalcy but express little sense of victory or stability. Residents report widespread anxiety about the future amid questions about what the conflict achieved.

stories.title: Army plans initial contract for HADES ‘ultra long-range’ effects in coming months
stories.summary: The U.S. Army plans to award an initial contract in the coming months for the HADES program's launched-effect capability, which could reach ranges of up to 1,000 km. A demonstration is scheduled for later this year.

stories.title: What role is China playing in the Iran war and how is it affected?
stories.summary: China is attempting to balance its alliance with Tehran against its broader global economic and diplomatic interests amid the ongoing war involving Iran.

stories.title: Settlers block Palestinian pupils' path to West Bank school with barbed wire
stories.summary: Dozens of Palestinian children in the Israeli-occupied West Bank have been unable to reach their school this week after Jewish settlers erected barbed wire across the path they normally use.

stories.title: US ‘locked and loaded’ to strike Iran’s energy sites if ordered, says Hegseth
stories.summary: U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said American forces are "locked and loaded" to strike Iran's energy sites if ordered. A top U.S. general added that forces are also prepared to resume combat operations if diplomatic talks fail.

stories.title: South Africa's Malema faces political crisis after jail sentence in firearm case
stories.summary: South African opposition leader Julius Malema was sentenced to five years in prison for firing an assault rifle in public during a 2018 rally. The conviction creates significant political uncertainty for the polarizing leader of the Economic Freedom Fighters party.

stories.title: Pope Leo Blasts ‘Tyrants’ in Thinly Veiled Critique of Trump
stories.summary: Pope Leo delivered remarks in Cameroon condemning "tyrants" driving global wars and the exploitation of Africa's resources. The White House responded critically to the Vatican's statements on war and peace.

stories.title: Republicans Twiddle Their Thumbs on Iran as Democrats Seethe
stories.summary: Republican lawmakers continue to provide political cover for President Trump's unauthorized military operations against Iran, despite growing internal misgivings. Democrats have expressed strong opposition to the conflict.

stories.title: Little enthusiasm as Palestinians gear up for local polls
stories.summary: Palestinians are preparing for local elections amid limited political choices and the practical difficulties of voting under Israeli occupation. Residents have shown little enthusiasm for the upcoming polls.

stories.title: Combat search and rescue’s uncertain future: As A-10s phase out, US Air Force faces questions of what comes next
stories.summary: The U.S. Air Force is proceeding with plans to retire the A-10 Thunderbolt II aircraft, which has long been considered ideal for combat search-and-rescue operations. The phaseout raises questions about what platform or capability will replace the A-10 in that critical mission role.

stories.title: Peace talks between US, Iran could take six months, officials tell Bloomberg
stories.summary: U.S. and Iranian officials told Bloomberg that peace talks between the two countries could take approximately six months, with recommendations to extend the existing ceasefire to allow adequate time for negotiations.

stories.title: 5 Things I Wish I Knew About Iran
stories.summary: The article discusses key details about Iran's regime that remain unclear in the aftermath of the war, highlighting gaps in public understanding of the country's internal dynamics.

stories.title: ‘The People Are Afraid of You’: In Rare Appeals, Celebrities Ask Putin to Address Russians’ Suffering
stories.summary: Russian blogger and influencer Viktoria Bonya posted a viral video calling on President Putin to address mounting social and economic pressures facing ordinary Russians. Other celebrities subsequently made similar rare public appeals.

stories.title: Trump expects Israel, Lebanon leaders at White House after ceasefire
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump said Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Lebanese President Joseph Aoun could visit the White House within four or five days following the announcement of the Israel-Lebanon ceasefire.

stories.title: Displaced Lebanese in Beirut uncertain if they can trust ceasefire
stories.summary: Displaced Lebanese people sheltering in Beirut said they do not yet trust that the ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon will hold, expressing uncertainty about returning home.

stories.title: Russians drop three glide bombs on Zaporizhzhia: One civilian killed, five wounded
stories.summary: Russian forces dropped three guided aerial bombs on Zaporizhzhia on Thursday at approximately 17:30. One civilian was killed and five others were wounded in the attack.

stories.title: Sectarian fears increase as a Beirut area says no to displacement centre
stories.summary: In Beirut's Karantina neighborhood, a proposed displacement center was cancelled amid rising sectarian tensions that echo divisions from Lebanon's civil war era.

stories.title: Attacks on US Muslims rose eleven-fold this year alone, advocacy group says
stories.summary: The Muslim Public Affairs Committee reported that attacks on Muslims in the United States rose eleven-fold in 2026. The advocacy group attributed the surge to tensions surrounding the US-Israeli war on Iran.

stories.title: Senate vote on arms sale shows ‘massive cracks’ in US support for Israel
stories.summary: The U.S. Senate held a vote on blocking arms sales to Israel, with 40 of 47 Democratic senators voting to block the sale of military bulldozers. Rights advocates called the vote a historic shift in U.S. support for Israel.

stories.title: Australia pledges to boost defense spend to 3% of GDP, says US remains key partner
stories.summary: Australia announced plans to increase its defense spending to 3 percent of GDP, adding 53 billion Australian dollars over the coming decade beyond earlier projections. Officials reaffirmed the United States as a key security partner.

stories.title: Ukraine’s Success Still Needs Troops More Than Robots
stories.summary: Ukraine continues to face challenges in mobilizing sufficient troops for its war effort, with skepticism about conscription reportedly fueled by Russian propaganda. Despite advances in drone and robotic technology, analysts argue Kyiv's military success still depends more on human manpower.

stories.title: Lapid says Israel's promises 'crash into reality' as opposition rages at Lebanon ceasefire
stories.summary: Israeli opposition leader Yair Lapid criticized the Lebanon ceasefire, saying Israel's promises "crash into reality." Lapid argued the war with Lebanon can only end by fully and permanently removing the threat to Israel's northern communities.

stories.title: EU chief urges ceasefire implementation in Israel-Lebanon truce
stories.summary: European Council President Antonio Costa welcomed the ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon, calling for its enforcement and verification on the ground. Costa affirmed continued EU support for Lebanon in a post on X.

stories.title: US to blockade Iran ports 'as long as it takes': Pentagon chief
stories.summary: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth warned that the American blockade of Iranian ports will continue "as long as it takes." Hegseth also threatened renewed military strikes against Iran if no deal is reached.

stories.title: Samsung removes support page that showed how to sandbox Russia’s state-backed Max app
stories.summary: Samsung published a support page demonstrating how users could isolate apps in a sandbox environment, using Russia's state-backed messaging app Max as an example. The page was subsequently removed.

stories.title: Netherlands pledges EUR 248M for joint drone production with Ukraine
stories.summary: Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten pledged EUR 248 million for joint drone production with Ukraine. The announcement underscored deeper defense cooperation between the Netherlands and Ukraine.

stories.title: Neutrality doesn’t mean indifference: Austria joins tribunal to prosecute Russia’s aggression
stories.summary: Austria announced it would join the tribunal to prosecute Russia's crime of aggression against Ukraine, becoming the 20th state to back the effort. Vienna stated that its traditional neutrality does not equate to indifference.

stories.title: Israeli military admit to posting AI photo of Lebanese journalist it killed
stories.summary: The Israeli military admitted to posting an AI-generated photo of Lebanese journalist Ali Shoeib, who was killed in a targeted airstrike in southern Lebanon in March. The doctored image replaced his press vest with a Hezbollah uniform. The Foreign Press Association accused the IDF of discrediting the journalist.

stories.title: Navy says commandos conducted unprecedented op amid war, thousands of kilometers away
stories.summary: The Israeli Navy disclosed that its commandos conducted an unprecedented operation thousands of kilometers from Israel during the recent conflict with Iran. The navy also said its submarines operated at the farthest-ever distance from Israeli shores. Vice Admiral Eyal Harel assumed command of the navy.

stories.title: US House rejects effort to pull forces from Iran war as Republicans stick with Trump
stories.summary: The US House of Representatives rejected a Democratic effort to withdraw American forces from the war with Iran, with Republicans backing President Trump. A Democratic representative warned the conflict had no exit ramps, while a Republican accused opponents of hypocrisy over past military actions.

stories.title: Cuban president defiant amid US pressure and energy blockade threats
stories.summary: Cuban President Miguel Díaz-Canel marked the anniversary of Cuba's socialist revolutionary declaration while facing heightened US pressure and threats of an energy blockade against the island.

stories.title: Three arrested after attempted arson at dissident Iranian news station in London
stories.summary: Three people were arrested after an attempted arson attack at the Iran International news station in London. The dissident Iranian media outlet cited growing threats and said it had refused entry to a suspicious vehicle shortly before an incendiary device was thrown at a nearby parking lot.

stories.title: Newly unsealed records reveal Amazon’s price-fixing tactics, California attorney general claims
stories.summary: Newly unsealed court documents filed in California's antitrust case against Amazon allege the company pressured independent sellers to raise prices on competitors' sites like Walmart and Target. California authorities claim this allowed Amazon to appear to offer lower prices. Amazon denies engaging in price-fixing.

stories.title: Full text of Israel-Lebanon 10-day ceasefire, sides aim for ‘lasting peace’
stories.summary: Israel and Lebanon agreed to a 10-day ceasefire affirming the two countries are not at war. Under the agreement, Lebanon committed to curbing Hezbollah attacks and will engage with Israel in talks to demarcate their shared border.

stories.title: Lyse Doucet in Iran: Destruction shows huge civilian cost of the war
stories.summary: BBC correspondent Lyse Doucet reported from Iran, where strikes have hit both military and civilian areas, highlighting the significant civilian toll of the ongoing war.

stories.title: French billionaire Bolloré sparks turmoil at Grasset as 115 authors leave publishing house
stories.summary: Over 115 authors announced they would leave the French publishing house Grasset after the surprise departure of its longtime CEO, amid billionaire Vincent Bolloré's expanding influence over French media. Bolloré, a conservative media mogul, has been reshaping France's media landscape through acquisitions.

stories.title: Opposition, northern mayors decry imposed ceasefires as Lebanon truce declared
stories.summary: Israeli opposition leaders and northern mayors criticized the Lebanon ceasefire announcement, with reports that government ministers were angered at learning of the truce from President Trump. Opposition figures Yair Lapid and Avigdor Liberman vowed to remove the Hezbollah threat if elected.

stories.title: High Court orders AG and Ben Gvir to reach deal on safeguarding police independence
stories.summary: Israel's High Court ordered Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara and National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir to negotiate an arrangement safeguarding police independence. The court rejected most demands from petitioners seeking Ben Gvir's removal from office.

stories.title: Zelensky: Netherlands to support decentralization of Ukraine’s energy system
stories.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky announced that the Netherlands will support decentralization of Ukraine's energy system. A draft document on the Dutch support has already been prepared, aimed at making Ukraine's energy infrastructure more resilient.

stories.title: Regions Calling: ‘Pain and Bitterness’ for Russia’s Buddhists
stories.summary: Police raided a Tibetan Buddhist festival in Moscow, drawing attention to the situation of Russia's Buddhist community, particularly in the southern republic of Kalmykia.

stories.title: RFK Jr and podcast guest suggest food is affordable in the US – despite rising costs
stories.summary: U.S. Health Secretary RFK Jr. and chef Robert Irvine claimed on the inaugural Secretary Kennedy Podcast that food in the United States is affordable if consumers shop wisely. The assertion was made despite rising food costs across the country.

stories.title: Trump says Iran agrees to hand over enriched uranium as deal nears
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump said Iran has agreed to hand over its stockpile of enriched uranium, stating the two sides are close to a deal to end six weeks of fighting. Iran has not independently confirmed Trump's account of the agreement.

stories.title: As Trump declares truce, Israel reached its limit of force against Hezbollah - analysis
stories.summary: Senior IDF commanders have acknowledged that Israel's military capacity alone is insufficient to eliminate Hezbollah. The assessment emerged as Trump announced a ceasefire, suggesting Israel had reached the practical limits of its military campaign against the Lebanese militant group.

stories.title: Hezbollah strikes north Israel ahead of Lebanon ceasefire announcement
stories.summary: Hezbollah launched a rocket attack that struck Kiryat Shmona in northern Israel, prompting firefighters to respond to resulting fires. The strike occurred shortly before an anticipated Lebanon ceasefire announcement.

stories.title: Lionel Messi buys Barcelona-based Spanish football club Cornella
stories.summary: Argentine football star Lionel Messi has purchased Spanish football club Cornellà, based in the same city as his former club FC Barcelona. Messi currently plays for Inter Miami in Major League Soccer.

stories.title: Shifting gears: Space Force moves to embrace space mobility for orbital warfare
stories.summary: The U.S. Space Force's new Objective Force plan calls for demonstrating on-orbit refueling and deploying operational "space tugs" between 2025 and 2030. The service is embracing space mobility capabilities to support potential orbital warfare missions.

stories.title: Punjab Assembly unanimously adopts resolution recommending Nobel Peace Prize for PM, CDF Munir
stories.summary: The Punjab Assembly in Pakistan unanimously adopted a resolution recommending the Nobel Peace Prize for Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and Chief of Defence Forces Field Marshal Asim Munir for their diplomatic efforts to promote a ceasefire amid the Middle East war.

stories.title: Outpouring of emotion as Turkiye buries school shooting victims
stories.summary: Funerals were held in Kahramanmaras, southern Turkiye, for eight children and a teacher killed when a 14-year-old opened fire at a school. The attacker arrived at the building with five guns. Mourners placed roses on the school steps.

stories.title: Emergency services in Ukraine 'need armored vehicles' as Russia targets rescue workers
stories.summary: Russian forces struck civilian areas across Ukraine with hundreds of drones and dozens of missiles, killing at least 16 people and wounding over 100. Paul Vazeux, founder of the NGO Dignitas Ukraine, said his organization will soon need armored vehicles as Russia increasingly targets emergency and rescue workers.

stories.title: Ukraine proposes special security partnership agreement to the Netherlands
stories.summary: Ukraine proposed a special security partnership agreement with the Netherlands. President Zelensky said the two countries signed documents covering their first joint weapons production on Dutch territory and a separate Drone Deal agreement.

stories.title: Man buried under rubble rescued alive 16 days after mine collapse in KP’s Mardan
stories.summary: A man was found alive 16 days after a marble mine collapsed in the Rustam tehsil of Mardan district in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. Rescue 1122 extracted him from a tunnel in the Darang area. Eight workers had been killed in the March 31 collapse.

stories.title: Trump says Netanyahu, Aoun may meet at White House
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump stated that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Lebanese President Joseph Aoun may meet at the White House in the coming days, following the announcement of a ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon.

stories.title: Army asks lawmakers to back production halt to Paladin line
stories.summary: U.S. Army Secretary Dan Driscoll urged lawmakers to support halting production of the Paladin self-propelled howitzer, citing lessons from the Ukraine conflict. Driscoll argued the Paladin is too slow to effectively set up and deliver fires in modern combat conditions.

stories.title: Trump says Israel and Lebanon have agreed to a 10-day ceasefire
stories.summary: President Trump announced that Israel and Lebanon agreed to a 10-day ceasefire, which could support broader efforts to extend the truce involving Iran, the U.S., and Israel following weeks of devastating war.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia pressed US to secure a Lebanon ceasefire to preserve Iran negotiations, sources say
stories.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman reportedly pressed President Trump in a private call to secure a Lebanon ceasefire in order to preserve ongoing Iran negotiations, according to anonymous sources.

stories.title: Death toll from Turkiye's second school shooting in a week rises to 10
stories.summary: A gunman armed with five firearms and seven magazines belonging to his father attacked a school in Türkiye, killing at least 10 people including himself. It was the country's second school shooting in one week.

stories.title: Search operations completed at site of Russian strikes in Dnipro: five killed, 26 injured
stories.summary: Search and rescue operations were completed in Dnipro following overnight Russian strikes on April 16. Five people were killed and 26 others were injured in the attack on the central Ukrainian city.

stories.title: Hezbollah says Israeli troop presence gives Lebanon ‘right to resist’
stories.summary: Hezbollah stated that the continued presence of Israeli troops on Lebanese territory gives Lebanon the right to resist. The group said any ceasefire agreement must prohibit Israeli forces from moving freely inside Lebanon. Lebanese Parliament Speaker Nabih Berri urged displaced residents to delay returning home.

stories.title: US House votes down latest effort to curtail Trump’s power to wage Iran war
stories.summary: The US House of Representatives voted down a resolution aimed at curtailing President Trump's authority to wage war against Iran. Nearly all Democrats supported the measure, which came a day after a similar resolution failed along party lines in the Senate.

stories.title: Rare pygmy hippo arrives in Israel to launch breeding program
stories.summary: A rare female pygmy hippo arrived at Hai Park in Kiryat Motzkin in northern Israel to launch a breeding program. The facility built a special enclosure, and a male pygmy hippo is expected to arrive in September.

stories.title: Belgorod Governor Says He’s Taking a Vacation as Rumors of His Resignation Swirl
stories.summary: Belgorod Governor Gladkov announced he is taking a vacation amid reports that the Kremlin may replace him with an army general who served in Ukraine.

stories.title: Trump: Israel, Lebanon agreed to 10-day ceasefire starting at midnight
stories.summary: U.S. President Trump announced that Israel and Lebanon agreed to a 10-day ceasefire beginning at midnight. An Israeli official said IDF forces will maintain their positions in southern Lebanon during the truce. Trump invited Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu and Lebanese President Aoun to the White House for talks.

stories.title: Nigeria warns of widespread floods in 2026, flags risks in 33 states
stories.summary: Nigeria's hydrological agency warned on Thursday that more than 14,000 communities across 33 of the country's 36 states and the Federal Capital Territory of Abuja face a high risk of widespread flooding in 2026.

stories.title: MEP: Magyar’s declarations are good, now action is expected
stories.summary: A member of the European Parliament stated that Hungarian political leader Péter Magyar's pro-EU declarations must be followed by concrete action. The MEP argued that Hungary has long obstructed EU unity on key decisions and urged the new government to return to constructive cooperation.

stories.title: Israeli strike kills seven in Lebanon hours before ceasefire
stories.summary: Lebanon's health ministry reported that an Israeli strike on the southern town of Ghazieh killed at least seven people and wounded 33, just hours before a 10-day ceasefire was due to take effect. Rescue teams continued searching rubble for survivors.

stories.title: Israel's Netanyahu says he agrees to a 10-day ceasefire in Lebanon
stories.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu confirmed Thursday he has agreed to a 10-day ceasefire in Lebanon. In a video statement, Netanyahu said the step was intended to advance peace efforts with Lebanon.

stories.title: Epstein row: UK’s Starmer faces calls to resign over report that Mandelson failed vetting
stories.summary: The UK government said Prime Minister Keir Starmer was unaware that former U.S. ambassador Peter Mandelson had failed his developed vetting by UK Security Vetting before officials overruled the recommendation. The revelation has prompted opposition calls for Starmer to resign amid the ongoing Epstein-related controversy.

stories.title: Eisenkot unveils aliyah plan to bring two million olim by 2048, vows to cut bureaucracy
stories.summary: Former IDF Chief of Staff Gadi Eisenkot unveiled a plan to bring two million immigrants to Israel by 2048 while reducing bureaucratic barriers. Eisenkot, whose Yashar! party has been gaining in polls, described himself as a strong candidate for national leadership.

stories.title: Viral Video in Russia Calls on IT Workers to Resist Internet Controls
stories.summary: A viral video circulating in Russia features a man identifying himself as Dmitry who urges IT workers to resist the government's internet control measures. He warns against building an "iron curtain" with their own hands.

stories.title: Viral Video in Russia Calls on IT Workers to Resist Internet Restrictions
stories.summary: A viral video circulating in Russia features a man identifying himself as Dmitry who urges IT workers to resist participating in the implementation of internet restrictions, warning against building "an iron curtain" with their own hands.

stories.title: Hegseth channels his inner Tarantino with fake Bible verse from Pulp Fiction
stories.summary: U.S. Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth quoted what he presented as a passage from the Book of Ezekiel at a Pentagon prayer session, but the wording closely matches dialogue from Quentin Tarantino's film Pulp Fiction. The incident occurred as Democratic lawmakers pursue articles of impeachment against Hegseth.

stories.title: US says it will pursue ships in Pacific Ocean supporting Iran
stories.summary: The US military announced it will intercept any vessel in the Indian and Pacific Oceans believed to be providing material support to Iran. Joint Chiefs Chairman Dan Caine said operations would target Iranian-flagged vessels and any ships aiding Iran.

stories.title: U.S. forces ready to restart combat if Iran doesn’t agree a deal, says Hegseth
stories.summary: U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth stated that American military forces are prepared to resume combat operations against Iran if Tehran does not agree to a deal. The U.S. military is currently enforcing a naval blockade on all ships attempting to enter or leave Iranian ports.

stories.title: Power minister reiterates govt’s apology for power cuts arising from ‘out of control’ situation
stories.summary: Pakistani Power Minister Awais Leghari reiterated the government's apology for excessive power cuts, citing the fuel supply crisis caused by the Middle East war as a major factor. He acknowledged shortfalls in electricity delivery during nighttime and peak hours.

stories.title: Defense reconciliation bill could come after ICE, border patrol effort: Graham
stories.summary: Senator Lindsey Graham, chair of the Senate Budget Committee, indicated that a defense reconciliation bill could follow legislation addressing ICE and border patrol funding. Graham said defense hawks want defense spending included but he aims to keep the bill focused.

stories.title: Counter-terror police investigate London arson attacks on Iranian and Jewish targets
stories.summary: UK counter-terrorism police are investigating three separate arson attacks in London targeting the offices of Iran International, a Persian-language dissident news channel, as well as a synagogue and a Jewish charity ambulance. Authorities are examining whether the Iranian state may be behind the attacks.

stories.title: Ukraine’s forces destroy Russian fuel trains near Luhansk
stories.summary: Ukrainian defense forces destroyed Russian fuel trains near Luhansk in eastern Ukraine. The strikes targeted enemy logistics and supply infrastructure in the Russian-occupied area.

stories.title: Ex-Arsenal and Liverpool keeper Manninger killed in car crash with train
stories.summary: Former goalkeeper Alex Manninger, who played for Arsenal, Liverpool, and Juventus and earned 33 caps for Austria, was killed in a car crash involving a train.

stories.title: Leo and "the tyrants": Does new pope's defiant message resonate?
stories.summary: Pope Leo delivered a pointed message during a visit to Bamenda in Cameroon's restive English-speaking northwest, condemning those who manipulate religion for military, economic, and political gain. While interpreted as a response to U.S. President Trump, the remarks were also directed at Cameroon's 93-year-old president.

stories.title: Gaza’s new generation of journalists face challenges, but stay resilient
stories.summary: Al Jazeera correspondent Hani Mahmoud reported on a new generation of young, untrained but determined journalists emerging in Gaza to cover events on the ground amid ongoing conflict.

stories.title: Israeli settlers block Palestinian students' path to West Bank school with barbed wire
stories.summary: Israeli settlers placed barbed wire to block Palestinian students' route to school in the West Bank. Khalil Hathaleen, head of the Umm al-Khair village council, said the barrier prevented children from using their usual path through a valley to reach the school in the village center.

stories.title: Starlink outage hit drone tests, exposing Pentagon’s growing reliance on SpaceX
stories.summary: A global Starlink outage in August left two dozen unmanned US Navy surface vessels stranded off the California coast during a drone test, disrupting communications for nearly an hour. The incident highlighted the Pentagon's growing dependence on SpaceX's satellite internet constellation as a critical communications link for military operations.

stories.title: Mind-blowing power and speed of black hole jets measured for the first time
stories.summary: An international research team has for the first time measured the instantaneous power and speed of jets emitted by a black hole in the Cygnus X-1 system, located 7,200 light-years from Earth. The jets produce energy equivalent to 10,000 suns and travel at roughly half the speed of light.

stories.title: ‘Best drone’ innovation winner developing enemy drone recovery system with the Army Research Lab
stories.summary: Soldiers presented findings from the inaugural Best Drone Warfighter competition at the Army Aviation Warfighter Summit, highlighting work on an enemy drone recovery system being developed in collaboration with the Army Research Lab.

stories.title: Mossad, Shayetet 13 raid Lebanon's Naqura as Israel breaks new ground at sea
stories.summary: Israel's Mossad intelligence agency and the Shayetet 13 naval commando unit conducted a raid in Naqura, southern Lebanon. The operation reflects a broader expansion of Israeli naval special forces activity, paralleling ground force efforts to establish buffer zones in Gaza, Lebanon, and Syria.

stories.title: Israeli navy hits Iran, Hezbollah, Syria, Yemen, and Gaza targets with precision strikes
stories.summary: The Israeli navy reported conducting precision strikes against targets linked to Iran, Hezbollah, Syria, Houthi forces in Yemen, and Hamas in Gaza. The navy said over 1,000 naval combat soldiers operated at sea for more than 26,000 hours during a 47-day period of the Iran-Hezbollah conflict.

stories.title: Armenia detains pro-Russian opposition figures ahead of June elections
stories.summary: Armenian anti-corruption authorities detained 14 individuals linked to a pro-Russian opposition party on Thursday on suspicion of electoral bribery. The arrests came less than two months before Armenia's scheduled parliamentary elections in June.

stories.title: Labour and Lib Dem MPs demand ‘shameful’ Palantir NHS contract be scrapped
stories.summary: Labour and Liberal Democrat MPs in the UK Parliament called for the cancellation of a £330 million NHS contract with U.S. spy-tech firm Palantir, citing its work with Trump's ICE and the Israeli military. The government responded by saying it was "no fan" of the company's politics.

stories.title: SBU and drone forces destroy Russian fuel trains near Luhansk, cutting supplies to frontline troops
stories.summary: Ukraine's SBU and drone forces used FP-2 drones to strike Russian fuel trains near Luhansk. The attacks damaged railway tankers and rail infrastructure used to supply Russian mechanized units on the front lines.

stories.title: ‘Endless grief’: Turkiye mourns victims of second school shooting in a week
stories.summary: A 14-year-old student carried out a shooting at the Ayser Çalık School in Kahramanmaraş, Türkiye, raising the death toll to 10. The attack was the second school shooting in the country within a week, prompting national mourning.

stories.title: US and Iran weigh extending their ceasefire by two weeks
stories.summary: The United States and Iran are reportedly considering extending their ceasefire by an additional two weeks. Sources indicated that neither side desires a return to fighting as negotiations continue.

stories.title: No 10 claims Starmer did not know Mandelson failed security vetting until this week – as it happened
stories.summary: The UK government stated that Prime Minister Keir Starmer did not know until this week that former U.S. ambassador Peter Mandelson had failed his security vetting process. According to Downing Street, officials overruled the vetting recommendation without informing the prime minister or any government minister.

stories.title: ‘Whose is he?’: A Gaza father’s fight for a child who might not be his
stories.summary: Mohammed Lubbad, a father in Gaza, learned that his wife Amal had given birth before she was killed in Israeli air strikes. He now faces a struggle to confirm whether the surviving child is his.

stories.title: Gulf and EU leaders believe that at least six-months is needed for a US-Iran deal: Report
stories.summary: Gulf Arab and European leaders believe a comprehensive US-Iran agreement could take up to six months to negotiate and are urging both sides to extend the current ceasefire accordingly. They are also pushing for the immediate reopening of the Strait of Hormuz to prevent a global energy and food crisis.

stories.title: Turkey urges ‘constructive’ US-Iran talks to end war
stories.summary: Turkey called on the United States and Iran to pursue constructive talks to end the ongoing war. US and Iranian officials were reportedly weighing a return to Pakistan for further negotiations as early as April 18.

stories.title: US says it will pursue ships in Pacific Ocean supporting Iran
